summary: Read two integers n and start. Form a list of length n. At index i, counting from zero up to n minus one, store start plus twice i. Combine every stored value with bitwise exclusive or and write the single result. n is from 1 to 1000, and start is from 0 to 1000.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
